senses.gloss:
Nemi denotes in the Rigveda^1 and later^2 the ‘felly’ of a
chariot wheel. It was required to be of good wood (su-drū),^3
and was bent into shape.^4 Cf. Ratha.
1) i. 32, 15; 141, 9; ii. 5, 3; v. 13, 6;
vii. 32, 20; viii. 46, 23; 75, 5, etc.
2) Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa, i. 4, 2, 15;
Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad, ii. 5, 15, etc.
3) Rv. vii. 32, 20.
4) Rv. viii. 75, 5.
Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben,
248.
